verdicts.summary: Lean has a weaker form of it. The first display is matched at every order: `realized_profiles_uniform_eta_jets` gives, for each fixed k and each pair of compact sets KX, Kη, constants CE, CU with |∂_η^k(E_N - E_0)| ≤ CE/n and |∂_η^k(U_N - U_0)| ≤ CU/n for all n ≥ 1 — the paper's A_k is max(CE, CU), and the paper's sup over 0 ≤ j ≤ k follows by taking the max over the finitely many k' ≤ k. The second display is matched only at order 0: `realized_shears_uniform_bound` bounds |a_N - a_L| and |b_N - b_L| (Lean's angularShear/signedAxialShear against the loop data, with Lean's signedAxialLoop = -b) by C/n in sup norm, with no η-derivatives; a search of the repository for a jet/iteratedDeriv version of the shear difference found none, so the paper's B_k for k ≥ 1 is not stated. This is rated low rather than medium because the paper's own subsequent uses of B_k on pp. 42-43 are at order 0 only ((4.41) uses B_0 and P_0; the Step-4 replacement bound is ‖a_f - a_N, b_f - b_N, p_f - p_N‖_0 ≤ C_rep/N), and the Lean cone condition `InTrueCone` is pointwise, so the sup bound is what its route consumes.
